name: standard-iid-policy-confirmation-20261003
purpose: Explicitly parent-authorized two-family learner-aware policy test confined to standard public IID with unresolved entity mappings. Not verified patient-independent, clinical, general-SOTA or default-promotion evidence.

claim_boundary.claim_scope: Row-level standard public IID benchmark evidence only, under explicitly unresolved patient/entity mapping.
claim_boundary.limits: This is not a waiver for known repeat-entity or temporal leakage. If later evidence identifies available group IDs, repeated-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries, stop and review; do not drop or ignore them to preserve IID eligibility.

lineage.scope: Earlier strict-tier exclusions remain historical evidence. Only this separately qualified experiment is authorized.

preregistration.expected_counts_formula: 2 families *3outer folds *2learners =12 cases; each has8outcomes from6physical jobs, yielding96outcomes/72jobs.

sampling_semantics.rounding: Each calibration holdout has ceil(0.15 * current fitting rows); training receives the complement.
sampling_semantics.selection: Fixed repeated stratified subsamples; no outcome-based redraws, retries, deduplication or fraction search.
sampling_semantics.sharing: Plain and sigmoid-calibrated views reuse the same three fitted base procedures for each raw or FE physical bundle.

reporting_and_acceptance.policy_selection: Linear always uses single FE; LightGBM always uses plain85% FE ensemble. No task/dataset switches and no choosing from sigmoid-calibrated views.
reporting_and_acceptance.counterfactual_limit: Native FE references are single-procedure native-generation methods with final training-support clipping, not native FE ensembles; do not describe them as ensemble-matched counterfactuals.
reporting_and_acceptance.complete_pairing: For each family/learner/method require all3 scheduled outer folds before a family mean loss is complete. Do not average only successful folds or omit failed families.
reporting_and_acceptance.aggregation: Compute family-mean losses first. Paired relative improvement is1-L(policy)/L(reference); report both families separately plus equal-family mean/median by learner.

acceptance.positive_vs_each_raw_control: For each learner, equal-family mean relative improvement must be strictly positive versus BOTH raw single and plain85 raw ensemble.
acceptance.family_harm: No family/learner loss increase above5% versus either raw control.
acceptance.native_reference_gate: For each learner, mean paired relative improvement >=0 against EACH completely paired clipped native FE reference. No post-outcome reference selection.
acceptance.coverage: All96 outcomes and all72 scheduled physical jobs must be present; any unsuccessful/nonfinite/missing outcome or incomplete pair blocks broad positive claims. Retain failures/timeouts/RSS/budget skips.
acceptance.zero_reference_loss: Do not substitute epsilons or delete a family; undefined relative gains block automatic acceptance and require explicit absolute-loss reporting.

reporting_and_acceptance.win_tie_loss: Per family/learner/comparator: >1% relative improvement is win; <-1% loss; otherwise tie.
reporting_and_acceptance.intervals: Descriptive paired family-block intervals only. With two small source families, no population-level, patient-level, clinical or general SOTA inference is warranted; folds/views are not independent families.
reporting_and_acceptance.tier_reporting: Every prediction row, report and aggregate must retain the same qualified evaluation_tier and claim boundary. Do not pool with verified-entity cohorts or earlier confirmation results.
reporting_and_acceptance.calibration_reporting: Sigmoid arms are diagnostic-only within subsample85, never eligible primary policy variants. Show calibration contrasts separately with no post-outcome policy switch.
reporting_and_acceptance.resources: Report outcomes96, physical jobs72, success/failure and fully paired coverage, wall/RSS/timeouts and actual cumulative controller time. Shared fitting time is charged once per physical job, not summed across two prediction views.

method_semantics_documentation_only.single_fe: Existing single-importance frequency-aligned-robust pipeline; not bagged/gated feature selection.
method_semantics_documentation_only.bundles: Three existing complete raw/FE fitting procedures on fixed85% training subsamples. Plain view averages member probabilities; sigmoid view reuses identical bases and is diagnostic-only.
method_semantics_documentation_only.native_references: Unchanged OpenFE inductive/native and AutoFeat native generation/selection; no width truncation. Shared q0/1 clipping applies to the matched final learner, not upstream ranking. No native reference ensemble is fabricated.
method_semantics_documentation_only.clipping: Training-support numeric clipping q=(0,1), trained only on each fitting partition; no test statistics.
method_semantics_documentation_only.binding_limit: Descriptive text is not a new override mechanism. Exact controller protocol, source pins, sampling setting, method/learner policy and source hashes are the enforced identities.

budget.note: 72 physical jobs *900s =18h worst-case, so10h ceiling can yield budget skips. Do not double-count shared plain/calibrated fits as96 physical jobs. Preserve every planned outcome and actual controller budget accounting.

datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective postsurgical five-year survival-status classification. Preserve age at operation, operation year and positive axillary-node count. Status1 means survived five years or longer; status2 means died within five years. This is not a preoperative prognostic model, alternative time horizon or censoring-adjusted survival analysis.
datasets.unresolved_entity_mapping: The source describes surgical patient cases but does not verify a one-patient/one-index-operation mapping. Operation year remains a descriptive predictor, not proof of temporal generalization or a supplied longitudinal group index.
datasets.schema_review_notes: The three original native UCI predictors remain numerical with their original meanings. No label transformation, patient ID inference or outcome-history feature is added.

rights.obligations: Credit original contributors/UCI, retain license notices and prominently disclose unresolved entity mapping and retrospective endpoint limits.
